cases.title: You cannot reach the seats without choosing a fare package

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Bundle

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. On step 1, fill in every box for every passenger.
2. Do NOT choose a fare package.
3. Press 'Next'.
detail.expected:
You are not allowed to move on. The message 'Bundle selection is required' appears.
Step 2 is still not reached, so the seat map cannot be opened.

extra.value: A fare package must be chosen first, because it decides which seats you are allowed to take.

cases.title: Women-only seats are marked clearly

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Not supported by supplier: no women-only seat rule for Air Cairo

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Find the seats marked as women-only.
2. Check their labels, their markings and the colour key.
detail.expected:
Being a women-only seat does NOT by itself mean the seat is unavailable.
For a male passenger it shows as unavailable and reads 'Female designated seat, not offered for <first name>'.
For a female passenger the same seat becomes available and reads 'available for <price>'.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: These seats must be explained, not just silently blocked.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: Only works on a flight that actually has women-only seats - skip cleanly when it does not.
